subject: words
title: Silly words 2
about: Made-up words using the later spellings: magic e, ee, oo, ou, oi, aw, ar, or, er, ai, ay, oa and tch. The last level: if he can read these, he can read the whole first-grade code.
tip: Ask him to name the sound team before he reads the word.
